name: Liam O'Connell
bio:
Liam's path to motorsport was unconventional, starting in high-end restaurant kitchens in Auckland. He developed a reputation for impeccable standards and resourcefulness under pressure. A chance encounter catering a private event for a racing team owner led to an offer he couldn't refuse. He thrives on the logistical challenges of feeding a demanding race team, ensuring everyone is fueled and focused. 

At Andretti Global, Liam is known for his relentless pursuit of perfection. He meticulously plans every meal, considering dietary needs, local ingredients, and the team's performance goals. He is determined to elevate the standard of paddock catering, believing that a well-fed team is a winning team. His demanding nature ensures that quality never slips, no matter the circumstances.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed, with a slight wave
physical.description: Liam is of average height with a slightly stocky build, reflecting his love of good food.

quirks: Insists on using only organic, locally sourced ingredients whenever possible.
Carries a small notebook filled with recipes and nutritional information.
Has a habit of taste-testing every dish multiple times, often with dramatic pronouncements.
